roles._comment_MARKETINGSHARK: Both marketingShark roles take the same claude-sonnet-5 the council seats above take; the entries exist for their token caps, not for a different model. CHUM's is the venture's only quality-critical call -- native-register Czech plus English creative in one pass, where Haiku-class output is not acceptable for a public brand voice -- and at ~$0.05 the quality tier costs almost nothing. Switching either is PEOPLE's process, not a config edit.
roles._comment_BOOKSOFHISTORY: FOLIO and PLOT use Sonnet for editorial judgment and native story craft. The three research roles use Haiku. RESEARCH_GATHER permits five searches, below the design's eight-search ceiling: five $0.01 tools plus 4k prompt, 20k search-content and 4k output tokens reserve about $0.094. Reserving all eight with that content window would exceed the immutable $0.10 per-call cap, so the configured call tightens rather than raises the guard.
roles._comment_IMAGE: Superseded on 2026-08-08 by article-image-fit-2026-08-08 and extended on 2026-08-10 by the Titty Tuesdays visual loop. The system now has exactly four sanctioned image call sites and no more. IMAGE_GATE looks at candidate thumbnails before any of them can become a hero, on the Anthropic key the company already pays for, capped at $0.02 an article and $0.10 a day for the whole image programme. ARTICLE_ILLUSTRATION renders an abstract illustration between the licensed search and the FRAME plate; it is labelled as an illustration wherever a reader meets it, never as photography, and it runs only when both FAL_KEY and ARTICLE_ILLUSTRATION_ENABLED are set. AVATAR_IMAGE is owner-triggered portrait repair, which is not an article pipeline. TT_VISUAL_IMAGE and TT_VISUAL_IMAGE_FAL render two Titty Tuesdays garment proposals a day, one per provider, capped at $2.00 a month read back from the ledger, behind TT_VISUALS_ENABLED, both keys and six countersigned approvals; the garment is a product render the owner rates and it never becomes a product. Everything else stands: an unsanctioned image call site in an article pipeline is still forbidden, and the ladder still prefers a keyless licensed archive to anything paid.
